title: Design exercise: SAA-2.1-S03
scenario: Vantage Point Photo Labs takes print orders through a checkout API that calls, in sequence, the invoicing, label-printing and customer-notification systems. The label-printing system sometimes takes up to six minutes, so checkout requests time out at about 30 seconds and customers reorder, creating duplicates. A partner promotion can multiply orders 30-fold for an hour. Each of the three downstream teams must receive every order from the single checkout source, work through it at its own pace, and lose nothing if it is down for up to a day, while checkout must confirm within 2 seconds.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
The three downstream teams deploy independently; onboarding a fourth must not require a checkout change
No order may be lost if a downstream team is down for up to a day
No content-based routing is needed; every consumer takes every order

rubric.label: Checkout confirms within 2 seconds even when label printing takes six minutes
Each of the 3 consumers reads from its own durable buffer that retains orders for at least one day

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
